result_tail:
s on `/products/1` right around the complaint window are the likely direct hit.

Along the way I ruled out a separate, unrelated bug: `/products/3` always throws a `ZeroDivisionError` (500), but it's deterministic on every request and every occurrence in the log is from investigator probes — no real user has ever hit it, so it doesn't match "occasional/retry" and isn't the cause. It's noted in the journal as a latent finding for awareness, not the incident.

Since chaos is still armed, more occasional 503s should be expected until someone disables it (out of scope for me to touch — read-only).
